midnight-navy.$description: Midnight Navy — Primary text, headings, dark surface cards, logo wordmark — the dominant ink of the system. Deep enough to anchor the cream canvas without going pure black

warm-cream.$description: Warm Cream — Hero band background, alternating section backdrop — sets the warm, sunlit atmosphere of the brand

soft-off-white.$description: Soft Off-White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on filled blue — the base layer everything sits on

electric-blue.$description: Electric Blue — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

heather-violet.$description: Heather Violet — Muted secondary text, supporting body copy — keeps longer passages from competing with the Midnight Navy headings

signal-yellow.$description: Signal Yellow — Solution card fill, decorative high-energy accent — one of the candy-bright poster colors for the product grid

deep-teal.$description: Deep Teal — Solution card fill, decorative oceanic accent — reinforces the water brand narrative in the product grid

sky-wash.$description: Sky Wash — Solution card fill, soft brand-blue companion — a lighter blue tone for visual variety in card blocks

black-ink.$description: Black Ink — Outlined button stroke, icon strokes, text in solid dark contexts — used sparingly for maximum contrast outlines

brand-blue-drift.$description: Brand Blue Drift — Gradient terminus paired with Electric Blue — used in the subtle horizontal brand gradient for decorative washes

dopper.$description: Display hero headlines ('Hot, cold, or fizzy.') — a custom quirky face with tight line-height that sits like a poster cut-out. Substitute with Fraunces or a chunky display serif for close fidelity.

gilroy.$description: Headlines, subheadings, card titles, body emphasis — the structural workhorse. Weight 600 for section headings ('Explore our solutions'), 700 for card titles, 400 for body. Substitute with Manrope or Outfit.

apple-system.$description: System fallback for utility text and small body — inherits platform-native rhythm.
